verdicts.observation: The source says 'Any foe you attempt to inflict a fear upon'. The translation '所有被你灌注恐惧的目标' drops 'attempt' and implies only foes who were actually feared. Pinned engine 624a6732 game/modules/tome/data/talents/cursed/fears.lua:74-81 applyEffect sets EFF_HEIGHTEN_FEAR after the mindpower check but before the canBe("fear") immunity check at lines 84-87. A foe immune to fear still gets this effect without ever being feared. Suggest '你试图施加恐惧的敌人'.

'up to tier %d' is translated as '最高材质等级 %d', but here tier is the trap's own tier, not a material tier. Same file traps.lua:841 lists each design as 'Tier %d: name' using trap.tier, and the value comes from getTalentLevelRaw (line 850). Also, 'Known primable designs' is translated as '已学会的引爆方式', but %s is a list of trap designs, not trigger methods. The same entry also renders primed trigger two ways: '特殊的控制机关' and '特殊启动机关'.

The source says 'These bonuses override rather than stack with weapon mastery...'. Here 'these bonuses' covers both the %d%% weapon damage and the +30 physical power (guardian.lua:33-35). The translation '这个技能的奖励伤害取代…' narrows it to bonus damage only, so the physical power part of the override is lost. Suggest '以上加成取代而非叠加…'.
